spans.s: सुवर्षिक m. Natron, alkali.
सुवर्षिका f. Natron, alkali.
सुवर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) 1. Of good or beautiful colour, brilliant in hue, bright, golden; 2. of a good tribe or caste; 3. praiseworthy.
सुवर्ण (II) m. 1. A good colour; 2. a good caste; 3. a sort of sacrifice; 4. an epithet of Śiva; 5. a weight of gold equal to about 175 grains Troy.
सुवर्ण (III) n. 1. Gold; 2. a golden coin, प्रयच्छ तद्दशसुवर्णम् Mrich.iii.; 3. money, wealth, riches; 4. a sort of yellow sandal-wood; 5. a kind of red chalk.
सुवर्ण (I) a. (f. र्णा) 1. Of good or beautiful colour, brilliant in hue, bright, golden; 2. of a good tribe or caste; 3. praiseworthy.
सुवर्ण-अभिषेक m. sprinkling the bride and bridegroom with water into which a piece of gold has been dropped.
सुवर्ण-कर्तृ, -कृत् m. a goldsmith.
सुवर्ण-कर्तृ, -कृत् m. a goldsmith.
सुवर्ण-गणित n. a particular method of calculation (in arithmetic).
सुवर्ण-पुष्पित a. abounding in gold, e.g. सुवर्णपुष्पितां पृथ्वीं विचिन्वंति त्रयो जनाः.
सुवर्ण-पृष्ठ a. gilded.
सुवर्ण-रूप्यक a. abounding in gold and silver.
सुवर्ण-रेतस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
सुवर्ण-वत् a. 1. golden; 2. beautiful, handsome.
सुवर्ण-वर्णा f. turmeric.
सुवर्ण-सिद्ध m. an adept who has acquired gold by magical means.
सुवर्ण-स्तेय n. theft of gold.
सुवर्णक n. 1. Brass, bell-metal; 2. lead.
सुवह a. (f. हा) 1. Patient, enduring; 2. easy to be borne.
सुवह a. (f. हा) 1. Patient, enduring; 2. easy to be borne.
सुवासिनी f. 1. A woman married or single who resides in her father’s house; 2. a term of courtesy for a respectable woman whose husband is alive.
सुविक्रांत (I) a. (f. ता) Very valiant, bold, chivalrous.
सुविक्रांत (II) m. A hero.
सुविक्रांत (III) n. Heroism.
सुविक्रांत (I) a. (f. ता) Very valiant, bold, chivalrous.
सुविद् (I) m. A learned man.
सुविद् (II) f. A shrewd or clever woman.
सुविद m. An attendant on the women’s apartments.
सुविदत् m. A king.
सुविदल्ल (I) m. An attendant on the women’s apartments.
सुविदल्ल (II) n. The women’s apartments.
सुविदल्ला f. A married woman.
सुविधम् ind. Easily.
सुविनीता f. A tractable cow.

सुविहित a. (f. ता) 1. Well-placed, well-deposited; 2. well-furnished, well-supplied, well-arranged, सुविहितप्रयोगतयाऽऽर्थस्य न किमपि परिहास्यते Sak.i.; 3. well-done, पुत्रं माधवं पद्मावतीं प्रहिण्वता सुविहितम् M.M.i.

सुवी(बी)ज (I) a. (f. जा) Having good seed.
सुवी(बी)ज (II) m. The poppy.
सुवी(बी)ज (III) n. Good seed.
सुवी(बी)ज (I) a. (f. जा) Having good seed.
सुवीराम्ल n. Sour rice-gruel.
सुवीर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. Having great vigour; 2. of heroic strength.
सुवीर्य (II) n. 1. Abundance of heroes; 2. the fruit of the jujube.
सुवीर्य (I) a. (f. र्या) 1. Having great vigour; 2. of heroic strength.
सुवीर्या f. Wild cotton.

सुवृत्त a. (f. त्ता) 1. Virtuous, good, मयि तस्य सुवृत्त वर्तते लघुसंदेशपदा सरस्वती R.viii.77; 2. well-rounded, beautifully globular, e.g. सुमुखोऽपि सुवृत्तेऽपि सन्मार्गपतितोऽपि च । महतां पादलग्नोऽपि व्यथयत्येव कंटकः (where the word is used in both the senses).

सुवेल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Calm; 2. submissive.
सुवेल (II) m. An epithet of the Trikūṭa mountain.
सुवेल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Calm; 2. submissive.
सुव्रत (I) a. (f. ता) Strictly religious or virtuous.
सुव्रत (II) m. A religious student.
सुव्रत (I) a. (f. ता) Strictly religious or virtuous.
सुव्रता f. 1. A virtuous wife; 2. a tractable cow.
